identity-and-party-apis/global-party-api: Look up party data — persons and companies — already held by If P&C: fetch common basic information such as name, contact details and identifiers. The See Party API supports searching by unique If id, social security number, corporate identification number or customer number, and returns curated, real-time data. Access is scope-based; the read scope is party.read. The APIs are cloud-hosted and intended for system-to-system integration across platforms, partners and services. The source states no country restriction; the products are described as global rather than market-specific. Pick see-party when you need to read existing party details or resolve a customer identifier before other calls. Not for: quoting or buying policies (see the mobility, person and property pages), claims data (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage, industrial/industrial-read-claims-apis), lead handling (communication/prospects-and-opportunities-apis), or event push (communication/event-subscription).
claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usag: Looks up existing If claims: fetch a single claim by claim number, or search for a set of claims using a customer's personal identifier, with search parameters and additional criteria to narrow results, returning real-time claim status (including whether a claim is already opened or closed). Called by partner companies that lack access to If's internal claim history systems, typically from their own service or agent applications on behalf of If; the source does not state the authentication method or market. Single product read-claims: pick it when you need to read or search existing claim data, not create it. Not for: reporting new travel claims (person/report-travel-claims), industrial claim reading (industrial/industrial-read-claims-apis), or Finnish person direct compensation claims (person/manage-direct-compensation-claims-person-finland).
communication/event-subscription: These APIs let partners create, read, update and delete subscriptions to If's event (Async API) products, so an application is notified when a state change occurs instead of polling a regular request/response API. Typical uses include being told when data in a customer engagement is updated, enabling real-time customer journeys. Calls are system to system by partners using If's event products; the source does not state authentication details or markets. Single product: pick event-subscription-management when you need to manage the state of event subscriptions themselves. Not for: the event streams or business data behind them, which belong to the domain pages such as industrial/customer-documents-api-and-events or mobility/road-side-assistance, and not for SMS or end-customer messaging.
communication/prospects-and-opportunitie: Registers sales leads into If's CRM: partners and internal If systems POST prospects and sales opportunities, referral leads, and personal insurance leads (with extra handling for health-related information), and partners can pull leads If shares with them via Retrieve Leads Info, querying by lead group and creation timestamp or fetching a single lead by lead group and lead id. Callers are partner systems, If-provided front-ends such as portals, if.xx contact request forms, and internal If processes. Access is multi-level secured: first level via Curity scope, second level granted by If's Application Development team (crm.it@if.se). Covers If's Business Areas; the source names no specific country. Pick register-prospects-and-opportunities for general leads and contact requests; register-referral-leads for referrals captured outside a sales context. Not for: quoting or buying policies, or push-style notifications (communication/event-subscription).
industrial/customer-documents-api-and-ev: These APIs look up document types and document metadata (policy number, company, publishing date and similar) in the If Login Industrial system, download document files by DocumentId, and notify consumers via webhook when documents are created or changed. Callers are brokers, enterprise customers and third-party systems integrating backend-to-backend: an active If Login Industrial user, a valid API key, and OAuth client credentials that must never be used from mobile or web apps. The source does not state a market. Pick retrieve-customer-documents to fetch document types, metadata and files for archiving policies and invoices at scale; pick customer-documents-events to subscribe a webhook for update notifications, used together with the retrieve API. Not for: claims data (industrial/industrial-read-claims-apis, claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage) or general event subscription (communication/event-subscription).
industrial/industrial-read-claims-apis: Read-only APIs for Industrial claims data. Retrieve a company's claims across all lines of business, retrieve claims bookings (tracking claim amounts, reserves and other changes), and fetch supporting reference data such as related party or policy references that complements the other two. Data is refreshed every 24 hours. Called by Industrial clients, brokers, or integration partners accessing on behalf of clients; the source does not state authentication details or markets. Pick read-industrial-claims when you need claims, claims booking, or claims supporting information for Industrial customers. Not for: general external claims retrieval outside the Industrial context (see claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage), Industrial document retrieval or document events (industrial/customer-documents-api-and-events), party or customer master data (identity-and-party-apis/global-party-apis), or claims reporting, which these read APIs do not support.
mobility/branded-heavy-vehicle-insurance: Calculates prices and creates insurance quotes for heavy vehicles such as trucks and trailers in Sweden, and lets callers retrieve, update and delete those quotes. Quotes cover a chosen coverage level, mileage and add-ons, are valid for three months, and can be produced for private customers identified by SSN or commercial customers identified by an organization number. Vehicles need not be in traffic or have a registration number yet; a suitable coverage level is recommended from vehicle age, model and active warranties. Sweden only. Pick request-quote-branded-heavy-vehicle-insurance-se-system for system-to-system heavy vehicle quoting. Not for: passenger car quoting (mobility/car-insurance-sweden), motor coverage lookups (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), used car warranties (mobility/manage-used-car-warranty-sweden), or other Nordic markets.
mobility/car-insurance-apis-denmark: Requests a price for Danish private car insurance and lets the customer order it. Inputs that drive the price are customer data (age, address), car data (brand, model, year), mileage and deductible. One price for one product is returned, so there is no list of competing quotes, then the customer can order. Called from car dealer systems, system to system with OAuth scope car.purchase.dk; dealer employees are authenticated in their own system and the dealer employee ID is passed in the call. Consents for sharing data with If and for marketing use are handled. Denmark only. Product buy-car-insurance-dk covers both pricing and purchase. Not for: other markets, see mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland, mobility/car-insurance-norway, mobility/car-insurance-sweden; heavy vehicles, see mobility/branded-heavy-vehicle-insurance-se.
mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland: This page contains one product, request-price-car-insurance-fi, which calculates and returns a price quote for private car insurance. It supports used cars only; there is no stated support for new cars, and no purchase, policy issuance or lookup capability is described here. Access is granted through OAuth using the scope car.price. The market is Finland only; the API does not cover other countries. Pick request-price-car-insurance-fi when you need a Finnish private used-car premium calculation. Not for: car insurance in other markets, which are covered by mobility/car-insurance-sweden, mobility/car-insurance-norway and mobility/car-insurance-denmark; heavy vehicles, see mobility/branded-heavy-vehicle-insurance-se; other Finnish lines, see person/travel-insurance-apis-finland and property/householder-insurance-apis-finland.
mobility/car-insurance-norway: These APIs let partners quote and sell private car insurance for Norwegian consumers: request a quote by coverage and mileage, list coverage items, search brand codes, list Norwegian insurance, financing and leasing companies, purchase a policy, start a one-month free trial of If's best car coverage, and look up whether a vehicle registration number or VIN already has an active If engagement (Yes/No). OAuth scopes are named, e.g. car.quote.no and insurance.companylist.no. Norway only. Pick buy-car-insurance-no for full quote-and-buy journeys; request-quote-car-insurance-no for pricing only; tryon-car-insurance-no when customers need help choosing coverage; see-engagement-vehicle-insurance-no to avoid offering insurance to already-covered vehicles. Not for: car insurance in other markets (mobility/car-insurance-sweden, mobility/car-insurance-apis-denmark, mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland), boat engagement checks (mobility/see-engagement-boat-sweden), or Norwegian property and travel cover (property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway, person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway).
mobility/car-insurance-sweden: These APIs quote, buy and manage If-branded car insurance for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles in Sweden, covering the VRF, IMF and If-branded portfolios. They price coverage and mileage (including partner products such as Volvo Nationell Leasing or Renault Relax), place and update orders, submit customer contact details from a dealer system, and look up an existing customer's insurance engagement by SSN, org. number, registration number, VIN or insurance info. Partners call them system to system; the -external-user and -user variants are for end customers identifying themselves with Swedish BankID. Sweden only, no other geographies. Pick request-quote-branded-car-insurance-se for pricing alone; buy-branded-car-insurance-se for quote plus purchase; buy-branded-car-insurance-se-external-user for BankID-authenticated purchase; manage-orders-branded-car-insurance-se for orders on undelivered vehicles; submit-contact-info-branded-car-insurance-se for lead and TryOn contact data (stored 6 months); see-engagement-branded-car-insurance-se or its -user BankID variant for viewing policies, invoicing, deductibles, mileage and documents. Not for: Denmark, Finland or Norway cars (mobility/car-insurance-apis-denmark, mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland, mobility/car-insurance-norway), heavy vehicles (mobility/branded-heavy-vehicle-insurance-se), coverage text search (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), used car warranty (mobility/manage-used-car-warranty-sweden), payments (mobility/manage-payment-assignments-mobility-sweden), or claims (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage).
mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance: Looks up motor insurance coverage for Swedish cars: send a car registration number and an optional claim date, and the API returns a coverage report showing whether the car has coverage on that date and what type. If no claim date is given, today's date is used. Intended for If customers, claims advisors and If Partners across phone, web and partner body shop channels, typically to drive automatic claim registration and downstream claims handling; the source states no authentication details. Market: Sweden only. Single product, coverage-search-motor-insurance-se, for coverage lookup by registration number. Not for: quoting or buying car insurance (mobility/car-insurance-sweden), property coverage lookup (property/coverage-search-property-insurance), animal coverage lookup (other/coverage-search-animal-insurance), or reading claims (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage).
mobility/manage-payment-assignments-mobi: Use this page's API to run bundled invoicing for car insurance: fetch what a specific customer should be invoiced for their insurances for a chosen period, including base premium plus additional costs and credits from retroactive coverage changes and corrections, and update details held by If (for example the bundle end date) so future invoice data is correct. The calling party then issues one invoice covering the full cost of owning the car. Intended for financial partners selling products where car insurance is part of a bundle; system-to-system integration. Sweden only, and selected parts of that market. Product manage-payment-assignments-mobility-se is the only product here. Not for: quoting or buying car cover (mobility/car-insurance-sweden), coverage lookups (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), or payment protection (mobility/payment-protection-insurance).
mobility/manage-used-car-warranty-sweden: This page covers an API that lets car dealers handle Used Car Warranty products sold with a used car. Three operations are available: Check, to verify whether a specific vehicle is eligible for the Used Car Warranty and to retrieve the warranty price; Register, to register a Used Car Warranty for a specific car; and Cancel, to cancel an active Used Car Warranty for a specific car. It is called by car dealers; the source states no authentication details. The market is Sweden only. No individual product ids are published on this page. Not for: ordinary Swedish motor insurance quoting and buying (mobility/car-insurance-sweden), motor coverage lookups (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), payment assignments (mobility/manage-payment-assignments-mobility-sweden), or other countries' car insurance pages.
mobility/payment-protection-insurance: The Payment Protection Insurance API lets partners create and administer payment protection insurance (PPI) on behalf of an end customer, who may be a private person or a company. Callers can administer the objects insured, the insurance products and the policyholders, covering the fixed monthly cost tied to a financing arrangement such as a car loan or leasing fee. It is called by partners that have an agreement with If regarding a payment protection group insurance; PPI is written at group level. The API covers the Nordic countries. Use product payment-protection-insurance for the Payment Protection Insurance product, independently of the insurance portfolio. Not for: motor policies themselves (mobility/car-insurance-sweden, mobility/car-insurance-norway, mobility/car-insurance-apis-denmark, mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland) or payment assignments (mobility/manage-payment-assignments-mobility-sweden).
mobility/road-side-assistance: These products handle roadside assistance (RSA) case data. The RSA Case Data API lets partners submit case data about a towing/roadside incident so If can keep customers informed; RSA Case Data Events exposes the same case data — details of the roadside incident and the services performed by the RSA companies — as a real-time event subscription. Callers are If's RSA partners and alarm central operators working under a partner agreement, system to system; event product access is arranged by contacting If directly. Coverage spans If's RSA partners in the Nordics and Baltics, not a single country. Pick rsa-case-data-events when you need to receive case updates rather than submit them. Not for: buying or quoting motor insurance (see the mobility/car-insurance-* pages), finding a repair shop (mobility/workshop-locator-motor), or general event subscription setup (communication/event-subscription).
mobility/see-engagement-boat-sweden: This page exposes a single lookup API, see-engagement-boat-se, that retrieves a customer's active boat insurance in Sweden. Callers submit either a Swedish social security number (SSN) or a policy number and get back the customer's active boat cover. It is a read-only coverage check: it does not quote, buy or amend policies. Intended consumers are If partner companies, primarily boat assistance providers, who must confirm coverage before delivering assistance. Market is Sweden only. Not for: motor coverage checks (see mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), property coverage checks (property/coverage-search-property-insurance), animal coverage checks (other/coverage-search-animal-insurance), or roadside assistance flows (mobility/road-side-assistance).
mobility/workshop-locator-motor: Looks up workshops for a vehicle claim: given vehicle data, a location and the type of incident (for example a collision), it returns matching workshops with contact details, location, the services they offer, and the actual driving distance and time from the point of origin to each available workshop. Multiple workshop service types are returned in one response, such as glass and mechanical workshops alongside the most likely match. Workshop and partner network data is maintained by If's cost control motor purchasers. Markets: Norway, Sweden and Finland (Nordic). One product, workshop-locator-motor, for routing a vehicle to the preferred workshop. Not for: finding property or building contractors (see self-service/contractor-locator-api) or dispatching roadside help (see mobility/road-side-assistance).
other/coverage-search-animal-insurance: This page's single product, coverage-search-animal-insurance, looks up pet/animal insurance coverage: a caller submits a social security number or policy number plus a claim or incident date, and the API returns basic customer, animal and coverage details, including yes/no answers for individual coverages. It is intended for partners such as veterinary clinics identifying a customer and their animal's cover at point of contact; the source does not state authentication details. Market: all Nordic countries. Pick this product whenever the need is animal or pet insurance coverage verification rather than quoting or buying. Not for: motor coverage checks (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), property coverage checks (property/coverage-search-property-insurance), or claims retrieval (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage).
other/manage-insrt-ancillary-insurances: These APIs let a partner embed and manage Insrt ancillary insurance at the point of sale: purchase short-term rental/sharing-economy trip policies (one call per rental occasion), quote and buy warranty cover, buy deductible reduction for a given start and end date, and retrieve historic deductible reduction transactions by customer policy, purchase period or transaction. Called system to system by business partners distributing B2B2C under a contract; coverages, add-ons such as assistance, pricing and reduction levels are agreed with If. Available in all Nordic countries and beyond depending on contract model. Pick manage-insrt-ancillary-insurances for rental/sharing policies and deductible reduction purchases and lookups; pick manage-insrt-warranty-insurances for warranty quotes and purchases using registration number, insurance tier and retailer concept identifiers. Not for: mobility/manage-used-car-warranty-sweden, mobility/road-side-assistance, or country car insurance pages.
other/manage-signify-signing-requests: This page exposes the Signify signing-request functionality inside PSI. Its single API lets a caller send reminders for ongoing or active Power of Attorney signing requests and cancel an active Power of Attorney. It also supports making Power of Attorney requests sent by PSI users visible to all Fronten users. Callers are PSI users working with Signify; the source does not state an authentication method, and no market or country is stated, so do not assume Nordic coverage. Pick product manage-signify-signing-requests when you need to remind a signer or cancel a pending Power of Attorney. Not for: creating or reading customer or party data (identity-and-party-apis/global-party-apis) or retrieving customer documents (industrial/customer-documents-api-and-events).
person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden: These APIs generate real-time quotes and complete purchases of personal accident and sickness cover for adults. A caller submits a Swedish social security number and e-mail address, answers a few questions, and receives a price with the option to buy. Sweden only. Pick buy-accident-insurance-se for cover limited to sudden, unforeseen accidents such as falls or bike crashes; pick buy-accident-and-illness-insurance-se when the customer also needs cover for illnesses affecting health or ability to work; pick buy-adult-50-plus-accident-and-illness-insurance-se for the Vuxen 50+ accident and illness product. Sandbox access can be requested. Not for: child cover (person/buy-child-insurance-sweden), person/buy-health-insurance-sweden, person/buy-life-insurance-sweden, person/pregnancy-insurance-apis-sweden.
person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-n: These APIs price and sell If's Annual Travel Insurance in Norway: calculate a quote, list coverage item descriptions for the coverage options, and complete the purchase. Typical callers are partners, for example travel partners, embedding the flow in their own customer journey; version 1 supports only the customer buying or requesting a quote for herself, with no agent-on-behalf-of use cases, and payment via electronic payment agreement between the customer and If with regular invoices (no card, Vipps or partner invoicing). Norway only, private market. Pick quote-annual-travel-insurance-no for pricing and coverage descriptions; pick buy-annual-travel-insurance-no to complete the purchase. Not for: travel insurance in Finland (person/travel-insurance-apis-finland), other travel products (person/travel-insurance), travel claims (person/report-travel-claims), or Norwegian property cover (property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway).
person/buy-child-insurance-sweden: This page's single product, buy-child-insurance-se, quotes and buys If's Child insurance for private customers in Sweden. A caller submits the child's and guardian's social security numbers, an e-mail address and answers to a few underwriting questions, receives a price, and can then purchase the policy. It suits integrations where the customer already knows what they want and only needs a quote and a buy step. Market: Sweden only. The source states no authentication details, endpoints or other products. Not for: child insurance in Norway (person/buy-bankid for BankID-authenticated flows, person/buy-low-loa otherwise), nor other Swedish personal lines such as person/buy-health-insurance-sweden, person/buy-life-insurance-sweden, person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden or person/pregnancy-insurance-apis-sweden.
person/buy-health-insurance-sweden: This page's single product, buy-health-insurance-se, provides a quote-and-buy API for the private Health insurance product in Sweden: submit a social security number, an e-mail address and answers to a few questions, receive a price quote, and complete the purchase of the policy. It covers the BA Private Health product, whose promise is that needed care and treatment starts within 14 working days. Market: Sweden only. Use it when the caller already knows which product is wanted and simply needs pricing and purchase. The source states no authentication details. Not for: other Swedish person quote-and-buy flows (person/buy-child-insurance-sweden, person/buy-life-insurance-sweden, person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden, person/pregnancy-insurance-apis-sweden), or non-buying health policy operations (person/health-insurance).
person/buy-life-insurance-sweden: This page's single product, buy-life-insurance-se, quotes and sells If's Life insurance for private customers (BA private) in Sweden. A caller submits a social security number and e-mail address, answers a few health/eligibility questions, receives a price, and can then purchase the policy. It suits flows where the customer already knows they want Life cover and only needs a quote and purchase step. The source states no authentication method or caller type. Market: Sweden only; no other country is covered here. Not for: other Swedish person lines, use person/buy-child-insurance-sweden, person/buy-health-insurance-sweden, person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden or person/pregnancy-insurance-apis-sweden; for Norwegian quote and buy, see person/buy-bankid or person/buy-low-loa.
person/buy-bankid: These APIs quote and sell child insurance in Norway for children under 18, and list the coverage items behind those flows. Request Quote Child Insurance NO returns quotes for one or several children, including children not yet born; Buy Child Insurance NO completes the purchase for born children under 18 using scope child.buy.no, where the allowed authenticator is Norwegian BankID. Calls are made by the end user authenticating directly to the APIs with BankID. Market: Norway only. Pick buy-child-insurance-no-bankid to quote and buy; pick child-insurance-no-support-apis to list and read child insurance and to list coverage items for quote and buy. Not for: person/buy-low-loa (Norwegian child insurance without BankID), person/buy-child-insurance-sweden, or other Norwegian lines such as person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway and property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway.
person/buy-low-loa: These APIs calculate quotes for child insurance and complete the purchase of child insurance in the Norwegian private market, and list the coverage items used by both the quote and buy calls. Quoting works at a lower level of assurance: the customer requests a quote for herself (no agent-on-behalf-of support in version 1), for one or several children who may or may not be born yet. Buying applies to born children under 18 and uses scope child.buy.no with Norwegian BankID as the allowed authenticator. Norway only. Pick request-quote-child-insurance-no-system for system-to-system quote calculation and coverage item listing; pick buy-child-insurance-no-standalone to complete a purchase, optionally combined with the weakly authenticated quote APIs. Not for: person/buy-bankid, person/buy-child-insurance-sweden.
person/health-insurance: This page exposes one product, check-health-coverage (Check Health Coverage API), which looks up basic coverage information on an If P&C health insurance policy: given an If policy number (SP-number or similar), it returns yes/no answers for the coverage types relevant to the caller, such as physical therapy, medical examination or psychology. Callers are health care providers acting as If partners; the only input needed is a valid policy number. Markets covered are Norway, Sweden and Denmark. Pick check-health-coverage when you need a coverage check, not a purchase. Not for: buying health insurance in Sweden (person/buy-health-insurance-sweden), accident and illness policies (person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden), or coverage searches on motor, property or animal lines (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden, property/coverage-search-property-insurance, other/coverage-search-animal-insurance).
person/manage-direct-compensation-claims: This page's API validates and registers direct compensation claims for treatment costs at the point of care, returning instant confirmation at checkout on whether If covers the cost, in full or partially with the customer paying the deductible. Lookups and claim registration are done for a given customer's SSN. Callers are If's Finnish healthcare partners, integrating the API into clinic systems and supplementary digital platforms such as mobile apps; the source states no authentication details. Market: Finland only. Coverage applies to Finnish individuals holding private health insurance covering both accident and illness. Pick manage-direct-compensation-claims-person-fi for clinic-side claim intake. Not for: buying health insurance (person/health-insurance, person/buy-health-insurance-sweden), reading existing claims (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage), or travel claims (person/report-travel-claims).
person/personal-insurance-recommendation: These APIs generate personal insurance advice for Norwegian customers: submit life-situation inputs (education level, marital status, number of children, work category, income range, total household debt range, age) and receive recommended personal insurance products and insurance amounts, or an analysis of income loss and economic impact if the customer becomes unable to work, comparing insured and uninsured outcomes over the first year. Admin-Recommendation-PersonalInsurance-NO requires the end customer to authenticate with BankID. Market: Norway only. Pick analyse-impact-personal-insurance-no (scope person.analyseimpact.no) for impact and recommended life insurance amount calculations; pick list-options-personal-insurances-no (scope person.listoptions.no) to fetch the valid income, debt and work category option values for the other two APIs. Not for: buying or quoting cover, see person/buy-bankid, person/buy-low-loa, person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway.
person/pregnancy-insurance-apis-sweden: Registers If pregnancy insurance for an expectant mother: the caller submits social security number, e-mail and due date, and the API creates either the free basic policy (accident cover for the mother, death benefit after accident, cover from the day after registration) or the paid extended policy (SEK 1,150, also covers the unborn baby, congenital conditions and lasting complications, cover from the day after payment). Usable from your own online and offline channels. Market: Sweden only. Single product: register-pregnancy-insurance-se for both the free and paid pregnancy variants. The source states no authentication details. Not for: child insurance after birth (person/buy-child-insurance-sweden), health (person/buy-health-insurance-sweden), life (person/buy-life-insurance-sweden), or accident and illness (person/accident-and-illness-apis-sweden); Norwegian child cover uses person/buy-bankid or person/buy-low-loa.
person/report-travel-claims: This page exposes one product, report-travel-claims, which lets an If partner register a travel claim on behalf of a customer: the partner submits a defined set of parameters, including SSN, to check coverage and register the claim and its details, and the API routes the claim to the correct If claims system so it appears quickly in If's digital channels for If, the partner and the customer. Callers are external partners integrating system to system, authorised with the OAuth scope claims.travel.report. Typical incidents covered are travel events such as illness abroad or lost luggage. The source states no market restriction. Not for: quoting or buying travel cover (person/travel-insurance, person/travel-insurance-apis-finland, person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway); reading existing claims (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage).
person/travel-insurance-apis-finland: These APIs let partners quote and buy If's travel insurance in Finland: request a price quote for the Travel product, list coverage item descriptions, and purchase a policy based on a previously calculated quote. Callers are If partners integrating the flow into their own platforms, typically travel-sector partners but open to others; the buy API uses System Authentication (system-to-system). Market: Finland only. Pick request-quote-travel-insurance-fi to price a trip and retrieve coverage descriptions; pick buy-travel-insurance-fi-system to complete the purchase of a quote already calculated. Not for: travel quote and buy outside Finland (person/travel-insurance, person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway), reporting travel claims (person/report-travel-claims), or Finnish home cover (property/householder-insurance-apis-finland).
person/travel-insurance: This page offers a lookup API for travel insurance coverage. Given a social security number or policy number plus an incident/claim date, coverage-search-travel-insurance returns whether travel coverage was active on that date (yes/no) and a list of valid policies for the person or company. Typical callers are partners such as travel call centres identifying a customer who has fallen ill, been robbed or otherwise needs help abroad; the source describes Nordic travel partners but names no specific country or authentication method. Pick coverage-search-travel-insurance when you only need to verify existing travel cover. Not for: buying or quoting travel insurance (person/annual-travel-quote-and-buy-api-norway, person/travel-insurance-apis-finland), reporting a travel claim (person/report-travel-claims), or coverage checks in other lines (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden, property/coverage-search-property-insurance, other/coverage-search-animal-insurance).
property/branded-property-insurance-swed: This page exposes one read-only product, see-engagement-property (API See Engagement Branded Property), which looks up basic customer and property (home) insurance information held by If P&C for customers shared between If and the API Customer. It is used to display If home insurance details in a partner's own channel and to give a fuller picture of a customer's housing economics. Callers are API Customers with a partnership agreement with If P&C implying common customers; the Get Common Customers (SE) solution must first be used to obtain the SSN, which is the input to this API. Market: Sweden only. Not for: quoting or buying home insurance (property/buy-home-insurance-sweden, property/buy-try-on-property-insurance-private-sweden), coverage lookups (property/coverage-search-property-insurance), policy administration (property/property-policy), or boat engagement (mobility/see-engagement-boat-sweden).
property/buy-try-on-property-insurance-p: This page covers one product, buy-try-on-property-insurance-private-se, which creates fixed-price short-term "try-on" insurance policies for home and villa products from supplied customer and property input. It supports provisioning temporary policies with configurable durations and coverage scopes, and real-time pricing and eligibility checks, over secure endpoints with full audit logging. It is intended for external partners integrating digital onboarding flows, real estate platforms or financial service apps; sandbox access can be requested. Market: Sweden only. Not for: full-term home insurance purchase, use property/buy-home-insurance-sweden; coverage or product searches, use property/coverage-search-property-insurance; branded partner property offerings, use property/branded-property-insurance-sweden; policy administration, use property/property-policy; Norwegian or Finnish property needs, use property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway or property/householder-insurance-apis-finland.
property/coverage-search-property-insura: Looks up whether a property is covered by If property insurance and returns a coverage report containing customer information, policy details and insured object information, including every relevant object on the location and recently expired policies. Callers send an SSN for the private flow or a policy number for the commercial flow, plus an optional claim or incident date (today's date is used if omitted); if no relevant coverage exists, the response states that it is not covered. Intended for If customers, claims advisors and If partners. Covers all Nordic countries. Pick coverage-search-property-insurance for standard system integration; pick coverage-search-property-insurance-user for public apps needing an extra layer of security. A V2 is planned for spring 2026. Not for: motor coverage lookups (mobility/coverage-search-motor-insurance-sweden), animal coverage (other/coverage-search-animal-insurance), or buying and managing property policies (property/property-policy, property/buy-home-insurance-sweden, property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway).
property/householder-insurance-apis-finl: These APIs quote and buy householder insurance for apartments and terraced houses: list coverage items to retrieve product content, texts and files; request a quote from SSN, living area, address and home type; and complete a purchase using customer contact details. Callers are If partners integrating the flow for their end customers, plus If's own channels such as My Pages; purchase requires strong authentication. Finland only. Pick request-quote-householder-insurance-fi for coverage content and quoting alone; buy-householder-insurance-fi to purchase with user authentication; buy-householder-insurance-fi-system for coverage, quote and purchase with system authentication. Not for: Swedish or Norwegian home/property cover (property/buy-home-insurance-sweden, property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway), or Finnish car or travel cover (mobility/car-insurance-apis-finland, person/travel-insurance-apis-finland).
property/buy-home-insurance-sweden: This page's API generates real-time home insurance quotes and completes policy purchases across three levels of home insurance coverage. A caller supplies a social security number and living address, answers a few questions, and receives a price plus the option to buy. Callers are digital partners integrating quote-and-buy flows; the source does not state the authentication method. Market: Sweden only. Product buy-home-insurance-se: pick it when the customer already knows what they need and simply wants a price and immediate purchase of Swedish home insurance. Not for: property/buy-try-on-property-insurance-private-sweden, property/branded-property-insurance-sweden, property/coverage-search-property-insurance, property/property-policy, property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway, or property/householder-insurance-apis-finland.
property/property-policy: This page's API lets insurance brokers and partners register and administrate property insurance policies (for example home insurance) in If's systems: create, update and delete policies that the same broker previously created through this API. Input is the policy holder(s) (name, national identification number, phone, email) and the insured property (construction year, area, location and other technical data), plus validity date. The only output is a correlation ID; If processes the submitted data asynchronously. Called system to system by partners under an agreement, authorised with the OAuth scope property.policy.admin. The source does not state a market. Product admin-property-policy is the single product here. Not for: quoting or selling property cover to end users (property/branded-property-insurance-sweden, property/buy-home-insurance-sweden, property/buy-try-on-property-insurance-private-sweden, property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway, property/householder-insurance-apis-finland) or coverage lookup (property/coverage-search-property-insurance).
property/property-quote-buy-apis-norway: These APIs price and sell If's Norwegian home insurance on a partner's own site or app: request a quote from the property address and customer details (SSN, name), list coverage items and their explanatory texts, list Norwegian insurance companies as a helper, and buy by passing the quote ID plus customer contact details, which creates the policy in If's Norwegian private core system. Callers are If partners, including housing and non-property partners, using OAuth scopes such as property.householder.quote.no, property.householder.buy.no, property.householder.listcoverage.no and insurance.companylist.no. Norwegian market only. Pick request-quote-householder-insurance-no then buy-householder-insurance-no for contents (Innboforsikring) alone; pick request-quote-property-insurance-no then buy-property-insurance-no when house and contents are needed together. Not for: Sweden (property/buy-home-insurance-sweden, property/branded-property-insurance-sweden, property/buy-try-on-property-insurance-private-sweden), Finland (property/householder-insurance-apis-finland), coverage search (property/coverage-search-property-insurance) or policy administration (property/property-policy).
self-service/contractor-locator-api: Searches If's network of building and residential contractor and inspection partners for property claims. Callers supply the needed capabilities and the claim address; a ranking model returns a sorted list of partners with partner information and driving distance between the customer and the partner, so a claims advisor can invite the best-suited partner. The intended consumers are claims advisors and their systems; access to the single product contractor-locator-property uses the OAuth scope property.contractor.locator. Partner network covers Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. Pick contractor-locator-property for building and residential property claims partner search. Not for: motor repair shop search, which is mobility/workshop-locator-motor; not for buying or quoting property insurance (see property/* pages) or reading claims data (claims/read-all-claims-for-external-usage).
self-service/manage-insrt-ancillary-insu: Purchase and look up ancillary insurance sold alongside a partner's own product or service (B2B2C, point of sale). The suite covers purchasing short-term rental / sharing-economy trip policies, where each call represents one rental or sharing occasion sent at purchase time; purchasing a deductible reduction for a given start and end date at an agreed reduction level; and retrieving historic deductible reduction transactions for a customer policy, by purchase period or transaction. Called by distribution partners under a contract; coverages, add-ons such as assistance, pricing model and flow are agreed with If. Available in all Nordic countries and beyond depending on contract model, not a single-country product. Product manage-insrt-ancillary-insurances--self-service is the only product here. Not for: standalone motor, property, travel or person insurance purchase, or claims reporting.
